title: Lion cub holding a heart
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- lion cub body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="24" ry="20" fill="#E8A33D"/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="78" rx="13" ry="12" fill="#F6D08A"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="40" r="22" fill="#E8A33D"/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="40" r="22" fill="none" stroke="#C97B1E" stroke-width="6"/>
  <g fill="#C97B1E">
    <circle cx="30" cy="30" r="7"/>
    <circle cx="70" cy="30" r="7"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="19" r="7"/>
    <circle cx="26" cy="48" r="7"/>
    <circle cx="74" cy="48" r="7"/>
    <circle cx="31" cy="60" r="6"/>
    <circle cx="69" cy="60" r="6"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="63" r="6"/>
  </g>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="43" r="17" fill="#F6D08A"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx="32" cy="24" r="6" fill="#E8A33D"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="24" r="6" fill="#E8A33D"/>
  <circle cx="32" cy="24" r="3" fill="#F09BA0"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="24" r="3" fill="#F09BA0"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="38" r="4" fill="#3B2140"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="38" r="4" fill="#3B2140"/>
  <circle cx="44.5" cy="36.5" r="1.4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="58.5" cy="36.5" r="1.4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="8" ry="6" fill="#FBE3B0"/>
  <path d="M47 47 h6 l-3 4 z" fill="#C97B1E"/>
  <path d="M50 51 v3" stroke="#C97B1E" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M50 54 q-3 3 -6 0" stroke="#C97B1E" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M50 54 q3 3 6 0" stroke="#C97B1E" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx="36" cy="48" r="3" fill="#F09BA0" opacity="0.85"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="48" r="3" fill="#F09BA0" opacity="0.85"/>
  <!-- paws holding heart -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="78" r="6" fill="#E8A33D"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="78" r="6" fill="#E8A33D"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="78" r="2.5" fill="#F6D08A"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="78" r="2.5" fill="#F6D08A"/>
  <!-- heart -->
  <path d="M50 87 C42 79 36 84 36 89 C36 93 43 97 50 99 C57 97 64 93 64 89 C64 84 58 79 50 87 Z" fill="#F04C6B"/>
  <path d="M50 87 C42 79 36 84 36 89 C36 93 43 97 50 99 C57 97 64 93 64 89 C64 84 58 79 50 87 Z" fill="none" stroke="#FF9AB0" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="86.5" r="2" fill="#FFD3DD" opacity="0.9"/>
</svg>
